user_stories.title: Connect CRM account and contact master data to Customer Insights
user_stories.description: As a marketing data steward, I need to connect Dynamics 365 CRM account and contact master data as Customer Insights data sources, so that marketing audiences use the same customer records as CRM.
acceptance_criteria: - CRM accounts and contacts are available as ingestible data sources in Customer Insights.
- Connection uses organization credentials without separate marketing-only logins.
- Source refresh expectations are documented for marketing operations.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - Connection uses organization credentials without separate marketing-only logins.

user_stories.title: Ingest sales order and engagement data for unified profiles
user_stories.description: As a marketing analyst, I need to ingest sales orders and digital engagement data into Customer Insights, so that unified profiles reflect purchases and campaign interactions.
acceptance_criteria: - Sales order data can be mapped into Customer Insights as a data source.
- Engagement sources (for example web, email, events) can be linked to the same profile model.
- Marketing users can verify that profile metrics update after source refresh.

user_stories.title: Define match rules for unified customer profiles
user_stories.description: As a marketing data steward, I need to configure match and merge rules for accounts, contacts, and partner records in Customer Insights, so that duplicate profiles are resolved before segmentation.
acceptance_criteria: - Match keys (for example email, partner identifier combinations) are configured for profile unification.
- Duplicate profiles are surfaced for resolution per agreed marketing data governance.
- Unified profiles show a single 360 view per resolved customer or partner contact.

user_stories.title: Use ship-to attributes in Customer Insights segment rules
user_stories.description: As a marketing analyst, I need to use segment rules that use ship-to city or address attributes from sales orders when available, so that geographic targeting reflects delivery location not only account headquarters.
acceptance_criteria: - Sales order ship-to fields are available as segment attributes when order data is ingested.
- Sample segment can filter customers or orders by ship-to city (workshop Houston example pattern).
- Documentation notes gaps when ship-to attributes are not yet populated in source data.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - Documentation notes gaps when ship-to attributes are not yet populated in source data.

user_stories.title: Update install base segment after partner tracing import
user_stories.description: As a marketing analyst, I need to update device or install-base segment attributes after late partner tracing files are imported, so that vertical market classification reflects tracings received after shipment.
acceptance_criteria: - Tracing or spreadsheet import can update install-base or device records linked to distributor shipments.
- Updated attributes are available for Customer Insights segmentation after processing.
- Process documents manual versus automated tracing timelines discussed in workshop.

user_stories.title: Ingest distributor sold-to location from partner channel into CI
user_stories.description: As a marketing data steward, I need to ingest distributor-reported sold-to location from the partner channel into data available to Customer Insights, so that vertical segmentation improves when partners report where units were sold.
acceptance_criteria: - Partner portal or channel submission can capture sold-to location or vertical per serial or order line.
- Ingested values are linked to distributor and device or order context for analytics.
- Data appears in Customer Insights sources after agreed refresh interval.

user_stories.title: Provide account-level marketing profiles with contact drill-down
user_stories.description: As a marketer, I need to view unified Customer Insights profiles at account level with linked contacts, so that I can plan account-based campaigns without losing contact-level detail.
acceptance_criteria: - Unified profile view supports account-centric navigation discussed in workshop.
- Linked contacts are visible from the account profile context.
- Marketing users can build segments using account attributes and related contact attributes.

user_stories.title: Enable worldwide marketing analytics visibility for product marketing
user_stories.description: As a global product marketer, I need to access Customer Insights analytics and audiences that are not limited to a single sales region, so that worldwide product planning uses consistent customer insight.
acceptance_criteria: - Role or audience scoping allows product marketing to view agreed global insight datasets.
- Regional sales-only restrictions do not block worldwide marketing views defined in workshop.
- Access approach is documented for US, Canada, LATAM, Europe, and Asia stakeholders as applicable.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - Regional sales-only restrictions do not block worldwide marketing views defined in workshop.

user_stories.title: Analyze account consumable purchase patterns for marketing outreach
user_stories.description: As a marketer, I need to analyze account-level consumable purchase history alongside equipment context in Customer Insights, so that I can identify accounts that stopped buying Philips consumables.
acceptance_criteria: - Purchase history for consumable part numbers can be associated with unified account profiles when purchase data is in scope.
- Marketers can filter accounts with equipment history but missing recent consumable purchases.
- Workshop dependency on complete purchase data linkage is documented.

user_stories.title: Detect vertical sales trends for targeted campaigns
user_stories.description: As a field marketer, I need to see emerging vertical sales trends over short periods, so that I can launch timely campaigns when a vertical market momentum spike is detected.
acceptance_criteria: - Marketing analytics can compare sales or shipment volumes by vertical over a configurable recent window.
- Trend or threshold signal is available to marketing without waiting six months for manual tracing consolidation.
- Output can seed audience selection for Customer Insights campaigns.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - Trend or threshold signal is available to marketing without waiting six months for manual tracing consolidation.

user_stories.title: Create dynamic segments by vertical end-market
user_stories.description: As a product marketer, I need to create dynamic Customer Insights segments by vertical end-market (for example hospital, EMS, education), so that I can target campaigns by where products are sold or used.
acceptance_criteria: - Segment rules can filter on vertical or market category attributes when present on accounts, contacts, or orders.
- At least the priority verticals discussed in workshop (hospital, EMS, fire, military) can be represented as segment criteria.
- Segments refresh automatically when underlying source data changes.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - At least the priority verticals discussed in workshop (hospital, EMS, fire, military) can be represented as segment criteria.

user_stories.title: Capture end-market segment at e-commerce order entry
user_stories.description: As a marketing operations lead, I need to capture end-market or vertical category during e-commerce order entry when feasible, so that Customer Insights segmentation is accurate at order time.
acceptance_criteria: - Order capture exposes a field or classification for end-market or vertical where business rules require it.
- Captured values flow to data available for Customer Insights segmentation.
- Workshop limitation that not all order nuances are capturable is recorded as open design input.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - Workshop limitation that not all order nuances are capturable is recorded as open design input.

user_stories.title: Detect vertical sales trends for targeted campaigns
user_stories.description: As a field marketer, I need to see emerging vertical sales trends over short periods, so that I can launch timely campaigns when a vertical market momentum spike is detected.
acceptance_criteria: - Marketing analytics can compare sales or shipment volumes by vertical over a configurable recent window.
- Trend or threshold signal is available to marketing without waiting six months for manual tracing consolidation.
- Output can seed audience selection for Customer Insights campaigns.

negative_boundary_signal_lines: - Trend or threshold signal is available to marketing without waiting six months for manual tracing consolidation.

user_stories.title: Identify distributors serving multiple vertical markets
user_stories.description: As a marketing analyst, I need to build intersecting segments that find distributors active in more than one vertical market, so that I can tailor messaging for multi-vertical partners.
acceptance_criteria: - Separate segment definitions exist per vertical (for example hospital-focused distributors).
- An intersection or combined segment returns distributors qualifying for more than one vertical rule.
- Results are exportable for campaign audience selection.
